'Next Adventure' card on My Trips opens search sheet ('Search a country or city', example cities, 'No matching city', 'nearby'). Entry is My Trips; may duplicate that inventory.

Type 'France', tap the country result -> CountryDetailScreen. Needs typing 'France' into the search sheet; driver cannot type (card label is 'Next Adventure', Popular list only has Paris/London/Tokyo/New York City/Rome). Search sheet autofocuses its field, so type_text goes straight in; 'France' row is in the Countries section.

City travel sheet: 'Set your home airport', 'Search flights', fare row ('Checking fares for…', 'Price unavailable for this date — tap to search', 'Book' in Row), tours 'View tour', eSIM/guide/luggage rows, 'Coming soon', affiliate disclaimer. Never tap Book/affiliate links. Needs typing a city without a report (e.g. Lyon); driver cannot type and the Popular list only has cities with reports. (Next Adventure card label is 'Next Adventure'.) Bordeaux is in cities.json but has no city report (Lyon has one), so it opens the travel modal.

'Set Your Hub' airport search sheet. Do not pick an airport (changes user setting). Needs typing a city without a report (e.g. Lyon); driver cannot type and the Popular list only has cities with reports. (Next Adventure card label is 'Next Adventure'.)

CityReportScreen guide (itineraries, transport, costs, weather, hotels; 'Could not load this guide.'). Also via travel modal '<city> trip guide'. Popular list shown for an empty query (Paris/London/Tokyo/NYC/Rome) all have city reports.

Social StatsScreen 'Rankings' tab (My Stats/Friends/Rankings): 'Travelog collections', 'Unlock with Premium', 'Most visited countries/cities/landmarks', 'Show less', '% of users', 'All continents'. Entry is SocialHub.openStats (social/profile area, not Countries/Cities); path left to that agent.
